newsitem.title: UK: Britain find heroin in Polish football bus.
newsitem.headline: Britain find heroin in Polish football bus.

text.p: British customs officials found over 100 kg (220 lbs) of heroin worth eight million pounds ($13 million) in a coach taking Polish soccer fans home after Wednesday's match against England, officials said on Friday.

The 10 football fans and two drivers on the coach were detained but were subsequently released without charge and went back home to Poland on Friday, an official of the customs' National Investigation Service said.
The heroin was found in two cylinders running the length of the coach chassis during a routine search at Dover docks in southeast England.

The official said: "Investigators have so far uncovered no evidence to directly connect any of the 12 men to the heroin on the coach, which travels widely thoughout Europe. The inquiry will continue now both at home and abroad."
